description: Election Commission - K. G. D. D. Jayawardhana was Selected as the member of the Wanathawilluwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Wanathawilluwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for declaring a new elected member, which falls under the category of electoral processes and related matters.
